title: Jerry project fact
description: A single verified or inferred fact about GundariuM. Facts live in context.md and state.md as text, but this schema describes the shape when facts are captured in structured form.

claim.description: The claim itself in plain English

source.description: How this was verified. Example: 'forge test passed', 'addresses.ts line 12', 'live Basescan lookup', 'Vercel deploy confirmed', 'session evidence link'

notes.description: Optional caveats, date observed, or what would move this to a stronger label
